CreateAShrinkingNodeGroupTaskV2.instancesToBeRemoved: List of node IDs to be removed from the node group when scaling in
CreateAShrinkingNodeGroupTaskV2.k8sNodesToBeRemoved: List of Kubernetes node names to be removed from the node group when scaling in; at least one of instancesToBeRemoved or k8sNodesToBeRemoved must be specified
CreateAShrinkingNodeGroupTaskV2.cleanPolicy: Whether to retain the instances corresponding to the nodes when scaling in the node group; valid values: [Remain, Delete]
CreateAShrinkingNodeGroupTaskV2.deleteOption: Deletion options for the specified nodes; required when cleanPolicy is set to Delete
